controllerInitialization: Load and admit the immutable guest image into controller memory.
Initialize timer conversion, host page-size and RSS diagnostics.
Create one empty VM and one vCPU, then destroy both, before controller_ready to exercise hypervisor context initialization.
Map no guest memory and execute no guest instructions during hypervisor initialization.
Include empty-context initialization in controller startup diagnostics; measure every subsequent fresh guest, including guest zero.
perTrialStart: mach_absolute_time immediately before fresh anonymous guest allocation
perTrialIncluded: fresh mmap allocation and explicit zeroing of all guest pages
copy admitted image bytes into fresh guest memory
hv_vm_create, guest RX/RW mappings, fresh vCPU creation and register setup
execute guest and read its response registers
validate HVC exception class, exact expected value and zero status
validation compiler/instruction barrier before the stop timestamp
perTrialStop: mach_absolute_time after response validation has completed
perTrialCleanup: Destroy vCPU and VM and unmap guest memory before starting the next guest; cleanup is outside boot latency and must succeed.
inputs: Trial i, zero-based: gross=1000+200*i, adjustment=7; expect gross/200+7=12+i.
memoryObservation: After validated response and before destruction, mincore counts resident mapped guest pages. The sole guest mapping is 65536 bytes and cannot grow; observed full residency equals its peak bound.
failurePolicy: Keep every trial and every latency miss. An API, response-validation, residency or cleanup error stops the campaign and records incomplete/failed qualification. Do not retry a failed guest or discard outliers.
latencyStatistic: maximum over all 1000 valid trials; median/percentiles are diagnostics
diagnostics: controller current and peak RSS before and during the campaign
guest image, mapped, resident and residency-upper-bound bytes
ambient host load before and after campaign; no controlled isolation claim
host hypervisor kernel memory explicitly not measured
scope: Bounded checked-i64 arithmetic guest with HVC result mailbox. No general native runtime, guest scheduler, network/storage drivers, mutable heap or full unikernel-completion claim.
boundaryRationale: The capacity-query API does not guarantee hypervisor initialization. An explicit empty VM/vCPU lifecycle initializes those API resources without executing a guest. Any remaining first-execution lazy work remains inside measured guest zero.
